font-family.title: font-family Property
font-family.history: The font-family property specifies the typeface for text content.
font-family.tip: You can specify multiple font names, and the browser will use the first one that is available on the user's system.
font-family.code:
CSS font-family Property Example

This text uses Courier New font-family.
font-family.quiz: Which property defines the typeface of text?

font-size.title: font-size Property
font-size.history: The font-size property sets the size of the text.
font-size.tip: You can use various units like px, em, rem, or % to specify the font size.
font-size.code:
CSS font-size Property Example

This text has 24px font-size.
font-size.quiz: Which property controls the size of text?

font-weight.title: font-weight Property
font-weight.history: The font-weight property sets the thickness or boldness of text.
font-weight.tip: You can use values like normal, bold, or numeric values (100-900) to specify the font weight.

CSS font-weight Property Example

This text is bold using font-weight.
font-weight.quiz: Which property makes text bold or lighter?

font-style.title: font-style Property
font-style.history: The font-style property defines whether text is normal, italic, or oblique.

CSS font-style Property Example

font-variant.title: font-variant Property

line-height.title: line-height Property

line-height.tip: You can use values like 1.2 or 2 to specify the line height.

text-indent.title: text-indent Property

text-align.title: text-align Property
text-align.history: The text-align property sets the horizontal alignment of text inside an element.

direction.title: direction Property
direction.history: The direction property specifies the text direction, either left-to-right (ltr) or right-to-left (rtl).

direction.code:
CSS direction Property Example

This text is displayed right-to-left using direction.

unicode-bidi.title: unicode-bidi Property
unicode-bidi.history: The unicode-bidi property works with the direction property to control text embedding and overrides for bidirectional text.
unicode-bidi.tip: You can use values like bidi-override to specify the unicode-bidi behavior.

CSS unicode-bidi Property Example

This text uses unicode-bidi with direction to override text flow.

vertical-align.title: vertical-align Property

CSS vertical-align Property Example

overflow-wrap.title: overflow-wrap Property
overflow-wrap.history: The overflow-wrap property specifies whether text should break when it overflows its container.

word-break.history: The word-break property specifies how words should break when reaching the end of a line.
